question.wording: Are the disability benefits on this Form SSA-1099 paid for injuries incurred as a direct result of a terrorist attack directed against the United States or its allies?

options.label: Yes — all of them; not income

default.because: Benefits are not disability payments for terrorist-attack injuries unless a preparer says so

citation.wording: are generally not included in income if they are for injuries incurred as a direct result of a terrorist attack directed against the United States or its allies.
